notes.title: Tournament Update
notes.notes:
I added a solo campaign: a 64 players tournament with bots. (3 difficulty settings)

Bots are now a bit smarter, they use pathfinding to search for a target instead of looking at walls...

Other changes:

- added steam achievements - more will come.
- more musics
- in skill tree mode we can choose only one weapon.
- avoid paint brush selection with mouse wheel
-added a ring to crosshair to help with timings
- improved UI
- randomize player first spawn.

notes.title: Sea trampolines Update
notes.notes:
Hey! small update to announce a new map and more:

While I would love to see tryharders compete on this game, I think I should focus on the 'fun' instead. 
So I made a new map to reflect that choice. 

I also implemented controler support (only xbox for now) to allow casual players to play.
Also you can now create a local server to play in LAN.

[u][b] -- additonal gameplay changes --[/b][/u]

auto charge dagger & axe
axe bounce a bit more prononced
disable watermelon slice self damage
jump 1.75 => 2 meters
lava activation transition duration 3s => 5s

notes.title: Explosive Watermelon update
notes.notes:
Hi! Small update before the playtest today

[b]-- Gameplay Changes --[/b]

- The watermelon now has health points and can explode
- Added a paint brush, useless but fun

- The axe wont inflict damage when just lying still on the ground

[b]-- Bug fixes --[/b]

- Fix paint glitch at wrong location (was rare)

[b]-- Other/Polish -- [/b]

- Added double kill/triple kill/etc achievement voice
- Add canon sound when someone is eliminated of the game
- The barrel and helmet do not instantly vanish anymore after a kill 
- The dagger will be covered in blood after a hit
- Cosmetic hats are place above the helmet
